name: session-budget
description: Session monitor and predictive token-budget manager for Claude Code.

costRouting.title: Cheaper models for prose and searches
costRouting.description: On: long prose is written by a Haiku agent (session-budget:writer) and Explore searches run on Haiku, in every tier.

deferRareTools.title: Keep rarely used tools behind ToolSearch
deferRareTools.description: On: Artifact, Workflow, ScheduleWakeup, ReportFindings and ListAgents send only their names until used (about 6,000 tokens less per request).

defaultRemainingSteps.title: Remaining steps when no plan is found
defaultRemainingSteps.description: Used until a todo list gives a real count.

tiersPath.title: Tiers file (optional)
tiersPath.description: Absolute path of your own tiers.json. Empty uses the one shipped with the mod.

sharedDir.title: Shared folder for session records
sharedDir.description: Absolute path. Empty uses ~/.claude-manage. Sessions on this machine read each other's status here.

mailboxDir.title: Mailbox folder (a git clone of your mailbox repo)
mailboxDir.description: Absolute path with inbox/ and archive/. Empty uses <shared folder>/mailbox.

mailboxGit.title: Sync the mailbox with git
mailboxGit.description: On: pull --rebase, commit and push after each message. The folder must be a git clone.

character.title: Character
character.description: Character id from characters/manifest.json. Empty uses the manifest's default. Also /clawd <id>.

characterVariant.title: Character variant
characterVariant.description: Variant id (accessory or talking version). Empty means none. Also /clawd <id> <variant>.

webPanelUrl.title: Web panel (claude.ai artifact link)
webPanelUrl.description: Optional. Session records and usage are written to this artifact's database for a live web view. Also /web <url>.

charactersPath.title: Characters manifest (optional)
charactersPath.description: Absolute path of your own manifest.json. Empty uses the one shipped with the mod; asset paths stay relative to the shipped characters folder.
